description: Registration and login system using Supabase Auth with email/password, username uniqueness validation, and session persistence

userStories.title: Add Supabase client library and initialization
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Supabase JS client available in the app so that I can call auth and database APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Supabase JS client via CDN <script> tag in index.html (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2)
Script tag is placed before config.js and game.js
Create auth.js file that initializes a supabase client instance using SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from config.js
index.html loads scripts in order: supabase CDN, config.js, auth.js, game.js
No console errors on page load — supabase.auth.getSession() returns successfully
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Registration form UI on start screen
userStories.description: As a guest, I want to see a registration form on the start screen so that I can create an account.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Register' button is visible on the start screen overlay alongside the existing 'Start Game' button
Clicking 'Register' hides the main start screen content and shows a registration form
Registration form has three input fields: username, email, password
Form has a 'Create Account' submit button styled with the existing blue button style
A 'Back' link returns to the main start screen without submitting
A 'Already have an account? Log in' link is visible below the form
Form styling matches existing dark background, sans-serif font, good contrast
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Login form UI on start screen
userStories.description: As a returning player, I want to see a login form so that I can access my account.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Log In' button is visible on the start screen overlay alongside 'Start Game' and 'Register'
Clicking 'Log In' hides the main start screen content and shows a login form
Login form has two input fields: email, password
Form has a 'Log In' submit button styled with the existing blue button style
A 'Back' link returns to the main start screen
A 'Don't have an account? Register' link is visible below the form
Clicking the 'Register' link switches to the registration form, and vice versa
Form styling matches existing dark background, sans-serif font, good contrast
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Registration logic with username and email uniqueness
userStories.description: As a guest, I want to register with a unique username and email so that I can have my own player account.
acceptanceCriteria: Before calling signUp, the app queries the profiles table to check if the username is already taken
If username exists, the form displays 'Username is already taken' as an inline error
On submit, calls supabase.auth.signUp() with email, password, and options.data.username
If email is already registered, the form displays 'Email is already registered'
If password is too short (under 6 chars), the form displays the Supabase error message
On success, the user is logged in automatically and the start screen shows 'Welcome, [username]'
The registration form hides and the start screen returns to game-ready state
All errors display inline on the form — no browser alert() calls
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Login logic
userStories.description: As a returning player, I want to log in with my email and password so that my scores are recorded to my account.
acceptanceCriteria: On submit, calls supabase.auth.signInWithPassword() with email and password
If credentials are invalid, the form displays 'Invalid email or password' as an inline error
On success, the login form hides and the start screen shows 'Welcome, [username]'
Username is fetched from the profiles table using the authenticated user's ID
The start screen returns to game-ready state with Start Game button visible
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Auth state persistence and logout
userStories.description: As a player, I want to stay logged in when I refresh the page and be able to log out.
acceptanceCriteria: On page load, auth.js checks supabase.auth.getSession() for an existing session
If a session exists, the start screen shows 'Welcome, [username]' and hides Register/Log In buttons
A 'Log Out' button is visible on the start screen when the user is authenticated
Clicking 'Log Out' calls supabase.auth.signOut() and resets the start screen to unauthenticated state
After logout, the Register and Log In buttons reappear and the welcome message is hidden
The game (Start Game, canvas, gameplay) works identically whether authenticated or not
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
